title: Hindsight-Privileged RLVR: Single-Rollout Token Credit Without Group Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.20497v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models from checked task outcomes, but assigning a terminal reward to individual reasoning tokens or actions remains difficult. Group-relative methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) sample several attempts per prompt, but lose their reward-based learning signal when all attempts receive the same outcome. We propose Hindsight-Privileged RLVR (HP-RLVR), a single-rollout method that turns a completed trajectory's own future into token-level update weights. The generating policy snapshot scores each eligible token under its causal history and under a hindsight context containing the realized future and verifier feedback. A normalized Jensen--Shannon divergence between the two views weights the reward relative to a historical baseline, yielding bounded token credit for both successful and failed attempts, with no reference solution or learned critic. translated_title: 事后特权RLVR：无需组采样的单次轨迹词元信用分配
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）利用经过检验的任务结果来训练语言模型，但如何将最终奖励分配到各个推理词元或动作上仍然困难。以组相对策略优化（GRPO）为代表的组相对方法需要对每个提示采样多次尝试，但当所有尝试获得相同结果时，其基于奖励的学习信号便会失效。我们提出事后特权RLVR（HP-RLVR），这是一种单次轨迹方法，将已完成轨迹自身的未来转化为词元级的更新权重。生成策略快照在每个合格词元的因果历史条件下，以及在一个包含已实现未来和验证器反馈的事后上下文条件下分别对该词元进行打分，两个视角之间的归一化Jensen–Shannon散度相对于历史基线对奖励进行加权，从而为成功和失败的尝试都提供有界的词元信用，且无需参考答案或学习到的评论家模型。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HP-RLVR，一种无需组采样的单次轨迹RLVR方法，通过比较因果视角与包含未来结果和验证器反馈的事后特权视角之间的Jensen–Shannon散度为每个词元分配有界信用，从而在所有尝试结果相同时仍能提供有效学习信号。
en_tdlr: HP-RLVR is a single-rollout RLVR method that assigns bounded token-level credit by measuring the Jensen–Shannon divergence between a causal view and a hindsight-privileged view containing the realized future and verifier feedback, removing the need for group sampling, reference solutions, or a learned critic.
